prompt: A party room costs $\$40$ to rent plus $\$6$ per guest, and your whole budget is $\$100$. Solve $40 + 6g = 100$ to find how many guests $g$ you can invite. Give just the number.
hint: The room fee is paid once no matter how many guests come. Take care of it before the per-guest cost.

hints.text: The room fee is paid once no matter how many guests come. Take care of it before the per-guest cost.
Subtract $40$ from both sides to get $6g = 60$. Then divide both sides by $6$.

explanation: Subtract the room fee from both sides to see what is left for guests: $6g = 100 - 40 = 60$.
Each guest costs $6$ dollars, so divide both sides by $6$ to get $g = 10$.
Check: $40 + 6(10) = 100$, which uses the whole budget, so you can invite $10$ guests.

alternativeExplanations.title: Budget leftovers
steps: Pay the room first: $\$100 - \$40$ leaves $\$60$ for guests.
Each guest costs $\$6$, so $60 \div 6 = 10$ guests fit the budget.
